title: Hardercore
description: A project that keep the vanilla experience but enhance it by adding a progression in the game
body:
# Hardercore
Hardercore is not just another modpack — it's a complete reimagining of how Minecraft survival is meant to be played.

## 🔒 Gated Progression
At the heart of Hardercore lies a custom datapack that locks away the world's most powerful tools and dimensions behind real achievements. You don't just find a diamond sword — you deserve it first.
But it doesn't stop there. Even time works against you. Certain unlocks are gated behind real playtime, forcing you to slow down, adapt, and truly master each stage of the game before moving on. No rushing. No skipping. No mercy.

🗺️ Biomes & dimensions unlock as you progress through the game
⚒️ Items & tools are restricted until you meet the right conditions
⏳ Time-gated unlocks add a second layer of pacing you can't ignore

## ⚡Performance & Visuals
Hardercore keeps everything you love about Minecraft completely intact. No game-breaking mods, no alien mechanics. Just pure vanilla, supercharged:

🚀 Optimized performance with Sodium, Lithium, and more — buttery smooth even on mid-range PCs
🌅 Complementary Shaders included out of the box for stunning visuals without killing your FPS
🗺️ Quality of Life mods to keep the experience clean and intuitive without ever feeling like cheating
